C1711.title: Merchant Sentenced for Defrauding Government-Issued Consumer Vouchers
C1711.summary: Shenzhen Longhua District People Court disclosed that Xu, legal representative of a Shenzhen swimming pool, conspired with outsiders during a government consumer voucher campaign to fabricate consumption and redeem vouchers by sending bank collection codes. Xu took 20% to 25% of the voucher discount amount as a benefit fee and transferred the remaining money back, defrauding public and private property such as consumer voucher discount amounts, and was eventually sentenced for fraud.
